spec.description: KV cache pool breakdown. Stacked: actively used (kv_used_tokens) + evictable/radix-cached (kv_evictable_tokens) = total used. Overlaid as a dashed ceiling: max_total_num_tokens (pool capacity). The gap between the stack top and the ceiling is the free capacity (kv_available_tokens).
spec.title: SGLang: KV Cache Token Usage

spec.description: Internal scheduler sub-queues (overlap scheduler + distributed KV transfer pipeline). Prefill Bootstrap: requests waiting for KV bootstrap before prefill. Prefill Inflight: requests being prefilled. Decode Prealloc: prefilled requests waiting for decode KV slot preallocation. Decode Transfer: requests waiting for cross-worker KV migration before decode. These are usually 0 for single-engine online serving; they become non-zero under prefill/decode overlap pressure or distributed (PD-disaggregated) KV transfer.
spec.title: SGLang: Detailed Queue Statistics
